habits.boundary_condition: This should be treated as a soft bed-type default, not as something inferred mechanically from the current number of travelers or rooms.
habits.condition: When booking a hotel room and no room-specific separate-bed setup is explicitly requested.
habits.default_action: Ask for or filter toward rooms with a queen-size bed or larger, applying queen-or-king beds to adult/couple rooms in multi-room bookings when possible.
habits.exception_condition: If a specific room is requested with twin beds or another separate sleeping arrangement, honor that room-specific request instead of forcing a queen or king bed.
habits.name: queen_or_larger_bed_as_standard_hotel_room_default
habits.preference_value: Tends to prefer at least a queen-size bed for standard hotel rooms; a king-size bed is an acceptable larger alternative.
habits.rationale: All three independent hotel dialogues include a queen-size bed request. One dialogue broadens the acceptable option to queen or king for adult rooms, while another shows twin beds can be a room-specific exception rather than the general default.

source_evidence.contribution: Supports queen as the minimum bed size and king as an acceptable alternative for adult/couple rooms.
